scope: Broad source discovery with explicit exclusions and targeted semantic review. Not every keyword match was manually read, and not every scientific claim was independently retested.
limitations: The inventory excludes dependency/build environments, Git internals, AppleDouble metadata and protected OS directories. The protected directories reported by the inventory are Spotlight, Trash and TemporaryItems.

Generated Claude retrieval chunks (80,711 files) were inventoried and their conversation prefixes all mapped to the 82-record parent export, which was fully screened. Chunk contents were not individually checked for later edits.

Keyword screening can miss work that uses unrelated vocabulary. Binary arrays, images, audio, video, Git packs/bundles and model weights were not generally interpreted; selected arrays were inspected separately.

54 filesystem PDFs have no extractable text, mainly figures/icons and unrelated documents; no general OCR pass was run. Archive-document no-text cases are listed separately. One relevant mathematical proof page was rendered and visually checked.
Seven archive-document extraction errors are AppleDouble metadata sidecars (._ filenames), not unread primary documents. Their paired primary documents were covered by the document pass.

Two encrypted members of Sovereign_Monolith_FINAL_20260130_003048.zip remain unread. Two TAR members at least 200 MB (a training corpus and a monolith benchmark log) were not content-screened; exact paths are in the coverage ledger.

Antigravity PB files were byte-keyword screened and matching protobuf text leaves decoded. This heuristic is not a schema-complete semantic decoder and cannot certify hidden/compressed content. Immutable main-database retries found no nonempty WAL companions.

Cursor counts include duplicate current/archive snapshots. Bubble extraction covers text, richText, thinking and summary fields, not every code diff, image or attachment. JSON parse failures inside the original extractor were not separately counted.

Live Claude research searches, project inventory and selected recent message tails were read. Long cloud chats were not fully paginated; all cloud attachments and every cloud-only conversation were not exported or independently hashed.

Old assistant praise, ratification labels, timing tables and claimed test results remain historical claims unless a fresh check is explicitly identified. No RH proof, physical interpretation or asymptotic theorem is established by this audit.
Stores were read in place. Fingerprints record the bytes encountered; this is not an atomic snapshot of every application at one instant.
No original research file, app conversation, standing rule, repository history or remote was changed. New audit artifacts and local diagnostic outputs were written.
